detail: Pindahkan file dan menyimpan ke dalam folder tahun dalam nama file
Menghapus data di bawah tulisan tertentu, misal di sini "2023"
kode:
Sub HapusDataBawah2023()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim headerCell As Range
    Dim dataCell As Range
    Dim lastRow As Long
    Dim col As Long
    
    For Each ws In ThisWorkbook.Worksheets
        ' Cari kolom dengan header "2023"
        For Each headerCell In ws.UsedRange.Rows(6).Cells
            If headerCell.Value = "2023" Then
                col = headerCell.Column
                lastRow = ws.Cells(ws.Rows.Count, col).End(xlUp).Row
                
                ' Hapus data di bawah header, kecuali yang berisi rumus
                Dim i As Long
                For i = headerCell.Row + 1 To lastRow
                    Set dataCell = ws.Cells(i, col)
                    If Not dataCell.HasFormula Then
                        dataCell.ClearContents
                    End If
                Next i
            End If
        Next headerCell
    Next ws
    
    MsgBox "Selesai! Data non-formula di bawah kolom '2023' telah dihapus."
End Sub

detail: Kode yang digunakan untuk mengubah isi sel konten di excel menjadi komen, script merupakan module di visual basic
kode:
Sub ContentToComment()
Dim Rng As Range
Dim WorkRng As Range
On Error Resume Next
xTitleId = "Cell Content to Comment"
Set WorkRng = Application.Selection
Set WorkRng = Application.InputBox("Range", xTitleId, WorkRng.Address, Type:=8)
For Each Rng In WorkRng
    Rng.NoteText Text:=Rng.Value
    Rng.Value = "NA"
Next
End Sub

detail: Mengambil atau menampilkan semua formula/rumus yang ada di semua sheet
kode:
Sub ListAllFormulas()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim FormulaSheet As Worksheet
    Dim Cell As Range
    Dim lRow As Long
    Dim SheetName As String
    
    ' Buat sheet baru untuk daftar rumus
    On Error Resume Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Worksheets("Daftar_Rumus").Delete
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    Set FormulaSheet = Worksheets.Add
    FormulaSheet.Name = "Daftar_Rumus"
    
    ' Header
    With FormulaSheet
        .Range("A1").Value = "Nama Sheet"
        .Range("B1").Value = "Alamat Sel"
        .Range("C1").Value = "Rumus"
        .Range("A1:C1").Font.Bold = True
    End With
    
    lRow = 2  ' mulai dari baris ke-2
    
    ' Loop semua sheet
    For Each ws In ThisWorkbook.Worksheets
        If ws.Name <> "Daftar_Rumus" Then  ' skip sheet daftar rumus sendiri
            SheetName = ws.Name
            
            ' Cari semua sel yang punya rumus
            On Error Resume Next
            For Each Cell In ws.UsedRange.SpecialCells(xlCellTypeFormulas)
                With FormulaSheet
                    .Cells(lRow, 1).Value = SheetName
                    .Cells(lRow, 2).Value = Cell.Address(False, False)
                    .Cells(lRow, 3).Value = "'" & Cell.Formula  ' tambah ' agar tidak dihitung sebagai rumus
                End With
                lRow = lRow + 1
            Next Cell
            On Error GoTo 0
        End If
    Next ws
    
    ' Auto fit kolom
    FormulaSheet.Columns("A:C").AutoFit
    
    MsgBox "Semua rumus telah dikumpulkan di sheet 'Daftar_Rumus'!", vbInformation
End Sub
